title: viderichocolatefactory.com
captured_text:
Videri Chocolate Factory was started by a group of friendly folks who wanted to create wonderful chocolate , from bean to bar , everyday . We ’ re a cozy downtown chocolate factory that scrupulously sources every ingredient to ensure a high quality , responsible chocolate . We are hoping to change the face of fine , hand - crafted , artisan chocolate by being a welcoming chocolate factory that makes people feel happy and at home .
Cacao begins with the farmers and we have them to thank for all of our chocolate worldwide . We start with beans from Camino Verde and Eco Cacao in Ecuador , Lachua in Guatemala , Rayan in Mexico , Hacienda Jean Marie in Puerto Rico , Tumaco in Colombia , Reserva Zorzal and Oko Caribe in The Dominican Republic , Kokoa Kamili in Tanzania and Tien Giang in Vietnam . From there , we sort and roast beans to bring out their distinct flavors . While our commitment to ethical sustainable chocolate begins with cacao , it doesn’t end there . From the local ingredients we use in our bonbons , to the sustainable boxes we pack them in , to the local community organizations we support , we are committed to making the world a better place one treat at a time ❤︎
In 2023 , Sam Ratto , the owner of Videri Chocolate Factory , visited one of our sources in Guatemala , Lachua , along with our chocolate makers Mordecai , Jazzi , and Carrie . Photos above ↑
Videri ’ s doors are open to everyone and anyone curious about the process and taste of handmade chocolate . We believe the factory should be the happiest and most exciting experience possible . People who walk in our doors love the experience of chocolate , and actively seek to understand the source and quality of goods they purchase . Come on down for a visit and don’t forget to taste our delicious chocolate !

title: viderichocolatefactory.com
captured_text:
Did you know we sort all of our beans by hand ? Did you know we roast every bag of cocoa beans in our roaster ? Did you know a cacao tree produces fruit ? Come see our process and learn more about where cacao is grown , how it is fermented , and how we turn it into award - winning chocolate bars and confections . Our doors are open seven days a week for factory visitors to enjoy either a free self - guided tour or a paid , staff - led tour of our factory .
Learn about our chocolate making process at your own pace ! Follow our self-guided tour through the factory , reading about the steps and watching videos . Make sure you have your phone so you can scan the video QR codes . Ask our staff any questions you might have while you enjoy free chocolate bar samples . Self - guided tours take about 15 minutes .
Led by a member of our staff , our guided tours provide additional insight to our bean - to - bar process . Tours take between 30 - 40 minutes and include one of our mouthwatering bonbons at the conclusion of the tour . Guided tours have a 12 - person max , and they should be scheduled at least a day in advance .
